entities.title: The shared zone-rule fixture
entities.summary: demoZoneRules() loads the pinned demo bundle with its three zones; every UTV zone example uses it.
criteria: demoZoneRules() returns a ZoneRules with America/New_York, Europe/Paris and Atlantic/Reykjavik, in the file's order.
It reads conformance/rules/demo-zones.json from the repository root, not a copy and not the host's tz database.

checks.symbol: demoZoneRules > contains the three demo zones when loaded
